career_ladder.note: Recruitment under the Agnipath scheme is for a distinct 4-year engagement period. On completion of four years, up to 25% of each Agniveer batch is enrolled into the regular cadre of the Indian Navy as Sailors in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3. Subsequent promotions follow standard Naval Sailor cadre regulations.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Agniveer (Navy) involves three consecutive stages. Stage 1 is an Indian Navy Entrance Test (INET) Computer-Based Examination: for SSR (100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes covering English, Science, Mathematics, and General Awareness; 0.25 negative marking); for MR (50 questions, 50 marks, 30 minutes covering Science & Mathematics and General Awareness). Stage 2 comprises the Physical Fitness Test (PFT: 1.6 km run in 6.5 mins for males / 8 mins for females, squats, push-ups, bent-knee sit-ups), written re-assessment, and initial medical exam. Stage 3 is the Final Medical Examination conducted at INS Chilka upon reporting.

financial_package.note: During the 4-year Agnipath tenure, Agniveers receive a customized composite monthly package: Year 1: ₹30,000 (in-hand ₹21,000 + ₹9,000 Corpus Fund); Year 2: ₹33,000 (in-hand ₹23,100 + ₹9,900); Year 3: ₹36,500 (in-hand ₹25,550 + ₹10,950); Year 4: ₹40,000 (in-hand ₹28,000 + ₹12,000). Upon completion of 4 years, exiting Agniveers receive the 'Seva Nidhi' package of approximately ₹11.71 Lakh (tax-exempt). For candidates enrolled into the regular Navy cadre (up to 25%), basic pay is fixed at 7th CPC Level 3 (₹21,700).

financial_package.estimate_note: For regular cadre Sailor: entry basic ₹21,700 + 58% DA (₹12,586) + Military Service Pay (MSP ₹5,200 + DA) + HRA/rations yields gross ~₹38,000 to ~₹47,000. For initial 4-year Agniveers, customized package spans ₹30,000 (Year 1) to ₹40,000 (Year 4) per month.
official_perks: Seva Nidhi package of approximately ₹11.71 Lakh upon completion of 4-year engagement (completely exempt from income tax)
Non-contributory life insurance cover of ₹48 Lakh for the duration of engagement
Free ration, uniform allowance, mess amenities, and medical facilities on board ships and establishments
Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹5,200 per month upon retention into regular cadre
CSD Canteen amenities across naval bases and stations
Skill certificate recognized by Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship upon exit
